name: Glide
description_en:
Glide is a product in the No-code applications category. Its directory profile covers Application Templates, Integrations Management, AI-Assisted Development, App Integrations, Machine Learning, Drag and drop Builder, Workflow Management, Web Development.

Additional listed capabilities include Version Control, Mobile Development, Debugging, Code Assistance, Access Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business Freelancers. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $19.00. Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: define steps and route work through a process; track changes to files and support revision workflows; inspect program execution to investigate faults; provide contextual help during software development; restrict information and actions according to permissions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Glide 属于无代码应用软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括应用模板、集成管理、AI 辅助开发、应用集成、机器学习、拖放构建器、工作流管理、网站开发。

资料还列出版本控制、移动应用开发、代码调试、编程辅助、访问控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为中型企业 小型企业 自由职业者。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 起价为 $19.00. 另有持续免费方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：定义处理步骤并组织工作流转；跟踪文件变更并支持版本修订流程；检查程序执行过程以定位故障；在软件开发过程中提供上下文辅助；根据权限限制信息访问和操作。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
